News | September 10, 2026


## Northwest Bank Recognized in Forbes’ World’s Top Performing Banks 2026


---


##### Inclusion in the global list of 500 banks highlights Northwest’s strong performance, financial resilience and focus on long-term growth


**COLUMBUS, OH (September 10, 2026):** Northwest Bank, a full-service financial institution offering a complete line of business and personal banking solutions, announced it has been recognized in[Forbes' World's Top Performing Banks 2026](https://www.forbes.com/lists/worlds-top-performing-banks/) . The inaugural award recognizes 500 banks worldwide and is presented by Forbes in collaboration with Statista, a leading statistics portal and industry ranking provider.


Banks are assessed across four core pillars: profitability; growth and earnings quality; capital and funding resilience; and asset quality and efficiency. Banks were segmented into six tiers based on their total assets. Northwest Bank ranked 103 out of 115 banks in the $10-$20 billion total asset category.


"This recognition reflects the strength of Northwest Bank and the dedication of our team members who work every day to help our customers, businesses and communities thrive," said Louis J. Torchio, president and CEO of Northwest Bank. "We remain focused on building long-term relationships, delivering exceptional service and maintaining the financial strength necessary to support the people and businesses that rely on us.”


The Forbes’ list follows two other major 2026 honors for Northwest Bank, including being named to[TIME’s America’s Best Companies](https://www.northwest.bank/link/1b2cf613b8f3474985f10a68972a82e0.aspx) list and[Newsweek’s America’s Best Regional Banks](https://www.northwest.bank/link/4dbd48cdc4d14d0da048074ce8352640.aspx) list for the third consecutive year.


### About Northwest Bank


Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Northwest Bancshares, Inc. is the bank holding company of Northwest Bank. Founded in 1896, Northwest Bank is a full-service financial institution offering a complete line of business and personal banking products, as well as employee benefits and wealth management services. Currently, Northwest operates 152 full-service financial centers and 11 drive-up locations across Pennsylvania, New York, Ohio, and Indiana and provides customers fee-free access to more than 55,000 ATMs. Additional information regarding Northwest Bancshares, Inc. and Northwest Bank can be accessed online at[www.northwest.bank](https://www.northwest.bank/) .
